purpose: Refine the first hard complementary-cycle atom. Show that the six-state C4 EXACT2_4 sign relation is linearly equivalent over GF(3) to a three-coordinate vector of Hamming weight exactly one. Thus every complementary C4 is one projective three-way choice together with one nonzero orientation scalar.

input_signature.proper_C4: R4={a in {+1,-1}^4 : sum_i a_i=0}; equivalently exactly two coordinates are +1 and two are -1.

basis.fact: v1,v2,v3 are linearly independent over GF(3), lie in A, and therefore form a basis of the 3-dimensional zero-sum hyperplane A. The six elements of R4 are exactly +/-v1,+/-v2,+/-v3.

coordinate_transform.forward: For a in A define y_1=-(a_1+a_2), y_2=-(a_1+a_3), y_3=-(a_1+a_4) in GF(3).
coordinate_transform.invertibility: Because v1,v2,v3 form a basis of A, this is an invertible linear coordinate change between A and GF(3)^3.

main_theorem.name: C4_EXACT2_SIGN_RELATION_IS_PROJECTIVE_ONE_NONZERO3
main_theorem.statement: For a in A, a belongs to R4 iff y belongs to {+/-e1,+/-e2,+/-e3}. Equivalently exactly one of y_1,y_2,y_3 is nonzero.
proof: Each basis vector vj maps to ej and each -vj maps to -ej by the coordinate definition.
v5.3 proves R4 consists of exactly those six +/-vj states.
Invertibility gives the converse and excludes every other y.
main_theorem.projective_quotient: Modulo the unavoidable global scalar +/-1 on one local C4 signature, the six states collapse to exactly three projective directions [e1],[e2],[e3].

Hamiltonian_carrier_consequence.linear_forms: Each arc sum a_i is a GF(3)-linear interval form in Hamiltonian edge tensions. Therefore every y_j is also a GF(3)-linear form in those tensions.
Hamiltonian_carrier_consequence.local_constraint: A complementary C4 can be replaced exactly by the block condition ONE_NONZERO_3(y_1,y_2,y_3).
Hamiltonian_carrier_consequence.global_source: On a 4-regular Hamiltonian graph whose complementary 2-factor consists of C4 components, 3-colourability is equivalent to existence of nonzero Hamiltonian tensions satisfying one ONE_NONZERO_3 block for every complementary C4, together with the Hamiltonian cycle closure equation.
Hamiltonian_carrier_consequence.witness: Any satisfying tension reconstructs vertex colours by prefix integration after fixing one root colour.

positive: The six-state C4 atom is not an arbitrary six-state relation: it is a projective coordinate-frame relation with only three directions.
All local nonlinear information is isolated into exactly-one-nonzero among three linear forms.
firewall: Choosing one of the three projective directions independently for every C4 is a 3^m expansion and is forbidden.
The normal form is an equivalence, not a polynomial solver; the fixed-C4 Hamiltonian source remains NP-hard.
Do not drop the local nonzero scalar or Hamiltonian-edge nowhere-zero conditions.
not_killed: A polynomial matroid/projective contraction coupling the three directions across many C4 blocks.
A determinant/Pfaffian identity summing the three projective directions without enumerating them.
A minimax theorem for ONE_NONZERO_3 blocks of interval-linear forms.

next_target.name: E8_PROJECTIVE_ONE_NONZERO3_INTERVAL_MATROID_CONTRACTION_V5_5
next_target.directive: Exploit that every hard C4 block is a three-point projective frame: exactly one of three interval-linear GF(3) forms may be nonzero. Seek a polynomial global contraction/augmentation that handles all frames simultaneously. First test whether fixing only the projective direction makes the remaining sign/tension solve a polynomial linear-matroid problem; then determine whether the three-way direction layer admits a matroid-parity, delta-matroid, or determinant representation without 3^m expansion.
